in_marathi.name: Somvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Somvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Somvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Som' (Sun) and 'Vansh' (seed). It signifies the seed of the Sun and represents the idea of growth and prosperity. It is believed that a child named Somvansh will bring sunshine into the family and ensure its continued growth and prosperity.
